headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 5, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies secured a crucial win over the San Diego Padres, while the Baltimore Orioles dominated the Boston Red Sox. The New York Yankees edged out the Cleveland Guardians in a thrilling matchup, and the San Francisco Giants outlasted the Milwaukee Brewers in a high-scoring game.

Top MLB News
The Philadelphia Phillies took down the San Diego Padres 6-4, with Zack Wheeler pitching 7 strong innings and striking out 8. Jackson Merrill led the Padres' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs. The Baltimore Orioles secured an 8-2 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Willson Contreras hitting a home run (12) and contributing to the Orioles' dominant performance. The New York Yankees edged out the Cleveland Guardians 2-1, with Brent Headrick earning the win. The San Francisco Giants outlasted the Milwaukee Brewers in a 12-9 victory, with Jackson Chourio leading the Brewers' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

Injuries and Availability Impact
Kansas City Royals second baseman Jonathan India has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a left shoulder subluxation. Boston Red Sox shortstop Trevor Story has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a sports hernia. Atlanta Braves catcher Sean Murphy has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a fractured left middle finger. Toronto Blue Jays left-hander Joe Mantiply has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with left knee inflammation. Los Angeles Angels catcher Travis d'Arnaud has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with right foot plantar fasciitis.

Trades and Roster Movement
The Boston Red Sox have strengthened their pitching staff with the addition of left-hander Joe La Sorsa, acquired in a trade with the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Cincinnati Reds traded right-hander Kyle Nicolas to the Baltimore Orioles for cash. The Los Angeles Angels traded catcher Austin Wynns to the Atlanta Braves for cash. The Minnesota Twins traded right-hander Simeon Woods Richardson to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. The Pittsburgh Pirates traded right-hander Justin Lawrence to the Minnesota Twins for cash.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Phillies in Thrilling Matchup**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies took down the San Diego Padres 6-4, securing a crucial win. Jackson Merrill led the Padres' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs, while Zack Wheeler pitched 7 strong innings for the Phillies, striking out 8 and allowing just 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Red Sox 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a convincing 8-2 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Willson Contreras leading the charge at the plate. Contreras hit a home run (12) on a fly ball to left field, contributing to the Orioles' dominant performance.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Guardians in Thrilling Match**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged out the Cleveland Guardians 2-1, securing a crucial win in their latest matchup. Brent Headrick earned the win for the Yankees, while David Bednar secured the save.

top_news.title: **Giants Take Down Brewers in Thrilling 12-9 Victory**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants outlasted the Milwaukee Brewers in a high-scoring matchup, ultimately securing a 12-9 win. Jackson Chourio led the Brewers' offense with a strong performance, collecting 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs in 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Royals Update: Jonathan India to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Kansas City Royals second baseman Jonathan India has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a left shoulder subluxation. This move comes after initially being placed on the 10-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Bolster Rotation with La Sorsa Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox have strengthened their pitching staff with the addition of left-handed pitcher Joe La Sorsa, acquired in a trade with the Pittsburgh Pirates. La Sorsa joins the Red Sox as part of the deal.
